signal: VIX falling into new SPX lows
observed: VIX 15.46, -2.21% on the day, near its own session low of 15.30, while SPX printed 7709.90 LOD
claim: argues against continuation; move is positional/mechanical, not fear-driven
context_against_it: tape delta -30%, net GEX -6759 and deepening, all four level sources aligned short
retraction_reason: SPX fell 12 more points in 14 minutes; called it 'not the operative signal on that timeframe'
outcome: SPX bottomed 7698.15, recovered to 7712.56 by 13:38 CT; VIX never bid, low 15.14
verdict: signal correct, retraction premature and made near the low
lesson: a lone dissenting instrument is abandoned first precisely when the others are loudest; short-horizon adverse price action is not evidence against a structural read
